title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00038 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: Continued POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 413 m to 2 m. Avg. Tripping speed 987 m/hr.
00:30 - 00:45: L/d EZSV RT. Pulled PS-21 slips and installed master bushing
00:45 - 01:30: Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Meanwhile started to drain riser
01:30 - 02:15: R/u handling equipment for pulling diverter. Prepared to pull diverter
02:15 - 02:30: Performed TBT for n/d diverter and BOP
02:30 - 03:30: Removed tension cylinders on BOP
03:30 - 07:00: Removed master bushing and outer ring. Installed lifting eyes for diverter. Attempted to pull diverter, 7 ton overpull. Installed shims for releasing the diverter lock ring. Re-attempted to pull diverter. Installed tension cylinders and aligned BOP/SLICK joint with diverter.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT with ongoing drilling crew.
07:15 - 07:30: Prepared to pull diverter. Removed 2 x shims from diverter housing.
07:30 - 08:00: Performed well controll table-top at drill floor.
08:00 - 10:00: Pulled diverter and secured to 5 1/2" DP in set-back. Removed slick joint from BOP. Disconnected BOP tension cylinders.
10:00 - 10:30: Broke nt2 connector. Performed TBT for skidding BOP onto test stump.
10:30 - 12:00: Picked up BOP using BOP carrier. Skidded BOP and landed on stump. M/u nt2 bolt.
12:00 - 12:30: Removed scaffolding around riser.
12:30 - 12:45: Performed TBT for pulling riser.
12:45 - 13:30: Attached lifting arrangement to TDS bails. P/u 3 ton over pull on HP riser.
13:30 - 14:30: Loosened bolts on HP riser connector. 2 bolts stuck.
14:30 - 15:00: Worked on loosening bolts on HP riser connector. Meanwhile completed skidding checklist. Loosened bolts on hatch on well f-7. Installed kill wing manifold on XT on f-5.
15:00 - 17:45: Pulled and l/o HP riser. Prepared hatches in moonpool. Installed hatch on well f-12. P/u hatch on f-7 hatches between f-7 and f-9 for later operations). Meanwhile installed check valve in cement head. End of report
